doc.title: Chubby Jackson interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 14, 1998

title: Arrangers Mandel, Hefti and Burns; lunch with Ralph Burns
summary: Arrangers who could write such music, and a recent lunch with Ralph Burns.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: But we have to have people thinking. Like the big band, sure. Five trumpets, well yeah that’s great to have, it’s all in sections, and there’s a limitation to that as of now, but not with these kind of instrumentations. Different instruments. You know what I mean? Like you’d have French horns, you’d have anything in there. But somebody who knows how to write, like to me, Johnny Mandel and Neil Hefti and Ralph Burns. We just had lunch, Margo and I, with Ralph Burns.
Yeah. He came down from Florida — not from Florida — from Hollywood to do a thing on, I don’t know some guy. And he called us up and we went out. He’s too much that little guy.
